description: This file contains utility functions related to voice wake triggers and locale identifier normalization. The functions are designed to process string arrays and locale strings for use in voice wake functionality and locale handling within the application.

methods.name: sanitizeVoiceWakeTriggers
methods.description: Processes an array of words to clean and limit the number of wake trigger phrases, applying trimming, filtering, length limiting, and fallback logic.

methods.name: normalizeLocaleIdentifier
methods.description: Normalizes a locale string by removing user annotations, unicode extensions, and variant segments to produce a simplified locale identifier.
